I need to verify which customers are actually associated with these order IDs. I will proceed to list all orders to identify the correct customer IDs linked to orders 250, 251, and 255.

I have identified the customers associated with the order IDs. Order 250 is linked to customer 'acme', order 251 to 'birch', and order 255 to 'cobalt'. I will now retrieve the net balance for each customer.
I have retrieved the net balance for customer 'acme' (5519 cents). Now I need to get the net balance for customer 'birch'.
I have retrieved the net balance for customer 'birch' (15118 cents). Next, I need to get the net balance for customer 'cobalt'.

I have retrieved the net balances for all customers: acme (5519 cents), birch (15118 cents), and cobalt (41289 cents). Now I need to record the payouts for each customer. I will start with customer 'acme'.
I have successfully recorded the payout for customer 'acme' (5519 cents). Next, I will record the payout for customer 'birch'.
